Executed in any one year, the following minimum quantities of work , Providing, laying, testing and Commissioning of MS pipeline completed in all respects of 400 mm dia and above for 345 Rmt AND 700 mm dia and above for 345 Rmt , Providing, laying, testing and Commissioning of 100mm dia DI pipe completed in all respect for 100 mm dia and above for 1120 Rmt, Supply, laying, jointing, Testing and commissioning of service connections making bore holes for fix house service connections including road cutting, excavation, backfilling, disposal and road restoration for 112 Nos.
